reasoning_content:
Key: `{"minimumAmount":50,"withdrawalsEnabled":false}` — **minimum withdrawal $50**, and withdrawals currently disabled.

That's important: you work, earn, but can only withdraw at $50, and currently withdrawals are disabled (maybe until onboarding/team).

Now let me write credentials + findings to AKSES.md and answer.

Answer structure:
1. Akun Claru sudah dibuat & terverifikasi (email, password)
2. Onboarding 3 langkah: tour, join, payment — harus di UI
3. Setelah itu proyek muncul; lalu qualification
4. Fakta penting: minimum penarikan $50, withdrawalsEnabled: false sekarang
5. Bayaran $8-10/jam (klaim tweet) — belum terverifikasi
6. Next: user buka app.claru.ai, login, selesaikan onboarding

Let me save to AKSES.md and commit.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
add='''## Claru AI — kerja dibayar (17 Nov, akun dibuat)

Sumber: tweet @0xbigjayy (17 Nov) — "Earn $8 to $10 per hour on Claru AI".
Bisnis: jual dataset "Physical AI" (robotik/embodied). Annotator dibayar per jam.

### Akun (SUDAH dibuat + email terverifikasi)
```
email    : woybangsatkauuu+claru@gmail.com
password : Claru!2026xyz
userId   : e9a80ba8-b646-420e-8915-9783aca517cb
role     : ANNOTATORS | status CONFIRMED | emailVerified true
inbox    : h8pm2zbr@supply.claru.ai
```
Login: https://app.claru.ai (email+password BISA; tidak wajib Google)

### Endpoint (dari bundle JS)
```
POST /api/v1/auth/signup        {email,password}   -> 201 userId (auto-aktif)
POST /api/v1/auth/app-sign-in   {email,password}   -> 201 + cookie
                                __Secure-better-auth.session_token
GET  /api/v1/users/me           profil lengkap
GET  /api/v1/users/me/onboarding       -> {tourCompleted,appInstalled,payoutAdded}
GET  /api/v1/users/me/onboarding/steps -> [tour, join, payment] semua pending
GET  /api/v1/projects           -> 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED lalu 403 NO_WORKFORCE_ACCESS
GET  /api/v1/teams/me/projects  -> 403 "Team project access is required"
GET  /api/v1/teams/me/projects/eligibility
GET  /api/v1/payments/config    -> {"minimumAmount":50,"withdrawalsEnabled":false}
GET  /api/v1/payments/summary/me-> earnings 0
Verifikasi email: link di email "One last step" ->
  https://app.claru.ai/api/auth/verify-email?token=...&callbackURL=...
```
Auth = BetterAuth. Signup API **tidak minta captcha**.

### Alur untuk bisa kerja (WAJIB lewat UI)
1. Login app.claru.ai
2. Selesaikan onboarding 3 langkah: **tour -> join (profil/skill/pendidikan) -> payment**
3. Setelah `workforce access` diberikan -> daftar projects muncul
4. Pilih project -> "Start qualification" -> kerjakan tugas uji
5. Lolos -> bisa kerja & dibayar

### Fakta penting
- **Minimum penarikan $50**
- `withdrawalsEnabled: false` saat ini (17 Nov) -> belum bisa tarik
- Metode payout di bundle: **Airtm**, **Trolley** (bank/PayPal), `/payments/me/withdraw`
- Klaim $8-10/jam **belum terverifikasi** (dari tweet, bukan dari situs)
- Daftar dengan Google TIDAK wajib; email+password jalan
'''
t=t.replace("## Catatan keamanan", add.strip()+"\n\n## Catatan keamanan")
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
PY
git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Claru AI: account created+verified, onboarding flow and payout facts documented" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
